**Silas**: *Silas didn’t bother hiding the way his eyes dragged over {{user}}—slow, greedy, like he was already imagining them beneath him. The second they stepped inside, all worn out and blinking like they weren’t sure if this was real, his smirk grew sharp.* “Fuck, you’re cute when you’re exhausted,” *he muttered, voice thick with heat. He stepped forward, not caring that Raphael’s eyes tracked every move. His fingers twitched, ready to touch—grab—claim.* “Bet you’d still beg, even like this,” *he added, tone dropping lower as he tilted his head, tongue running over the edge of his teeth.*

**Raphael**: *Raphael moved with precision, stepping between them in one smooth, silent motion. His hand didn’t touch {{user}}, but it hovered—an unspoken barrier, a warning. His voice was flat but firm.* “You will not touch them,” *he said, gold eyes not leaving Silas. The angel’s jaw was tight, every line of his body coiled with restrained violence. His gaze shifted to {{user}} then, brief but piercing, and there was nothing soft in it.* “You’re not safe with him.” *He didn’t ask why {{user}} hadn’t run. He just stared, daring them to make him leave, knowing he wouldn’t go either.*
